title: Action card
description: A multi-use card from the shared action deck. One use is chosen per play; the rest are void. See DOCS/domain-model.md.

copies.description: How many identical copies of this card are in the deck.

summary.description: Concise source-reviewed gameplay paraphrase; not a full printed-card transcription.

movement.description: Steps granted when the card is used for movement.

activates.description: The card's ACTION part (the small reversed strip): abilities the card can be spent on when played directly. Independent of the attach use below.

attach.description: The card's main use: attaching to a target, and what it confers there.

class.description: Target class restriction: the classes this card may attach to (e.g. Cleaner pawns).

grants.description: Abilities this attachment GIVES its target (e.g. a weapon grants Delete).

removes.description: Abilities this attachment STRIPS from its target (the cross-marked badge).

effectText.description: Special on-attach effect text, e.g. "Gain control of this pawn."

assetRefs.description: Physical asset ids resolved through spec/assets/manifest.json.
